task: Task 5 bounded measurement; declared before execution

fixture.source: Task-specific original synthetic SVG, not a third production example
fixture.layer: one copied modules/artwork.mjs layer, fit contain, compiled cuts
fixture.audio: existing mixer produces intentional silence once per case

timing.preparation: Generate fixture, freeze once per case and prepare silent mix before any measured browser navigation. Record freeze and mix separately.
timing.navigationToReady: Node performance.now immediately before page.goto(waitUntil=domcontentloaded), ending when waitForFunction observes window.direction.status().frame===0. Includes navigation, eager imports/assets, first draw and readiness polling/protocol overhead. Excludes freeze, mix, worker/browser launch and page creation.
timing.navigationToFirstFrameReadback: Same start; ends after a separate page.evaluate returns frame-0 state and canvas.toDataURL(image/png) to Node. Includes PNG encoding and protocol transfer, excludes disk write/hash/assertion. This proves canvas readback, not physical display presentation.
timing.seekReadback: Node performance.now around one awaited page.evaluate: direction.seek(index), canvas.toDataURL(image/png), returned draw state and PNG data URL. Includes pause/draw/audio-currentTime assignment, PNG encoding, serialization and protocol return. Excludes audio seek completion, requestAnimationFrame/display presentation, PNG disk write/hash/assertion and RSS/disk sampling.
timing.warmup: No separate warmup. First frame precedes the 24 declared seeks; same group order for every run.

rss.method: ps pid/ppid/rss/comm snapshot; RSS in KiB (1024 bytes). Only the fresh Node worker and its current Chrome/Chromium descendants, with exact PIDs recorded. The sampler ps process is excluded.
rss.limits: Snapshots, not peak. Browser sum can double-count shared pages. Coordinator Node, ancestor/sibling/unrelated apps, exited/reparented descendants and OS memory are excluded. No global process arguments are retained.

disk.unit: logical regular-file bytes (lstat.size), no allocated-block claim
disk.cleanup: Playwright performs normal browser/profile cleanup on close. Retain remaining repository-local temp files and all evidence. Do not manually erase measurement evidence.
disk.limits: No symlink traversal; count symlinks/special files separately. Record vanished files during a non-atomic walk. Browser/OS writes outside inherited repository-local TMPDIR, OS caches/swap and APFS physical allocation are not measured. Root measurement-directory bytes accumulate and are audit-only, not a case comparison.

execution.runPolicy: Exactly three cases by three fresh-browser repetitions. Existing output rendering/playback has stopped. No whole video rendering, optimization, case expansion, number-chasing rerun or broad npm test.
execution.failurePolicy: Preserve partial performance.json, per-run result and full stdout/stderr/events. Stop on a failure. Explain cause before any necessary retry; never overwrite an earlier run.
